management_discussion_summary: FY2026 was a landmark year for NovaTech Industries.
The company generated revenue of Rs. 850 crore, up 18% year-on-year, driven by strong demand in our core manufacturing and digital services segments.
Operating margins improved on the back of cost discipline and operational efficiency initiatives.
The management expects continued double-digit revenue growth in FY2027, supported by new product launches and capacity expansion.
